name: Landsort
description: The southernmost SAT section on Öja/Landsort, combining village and harbor services with lighthouse views, exposed cliffs, forest singletrack, grazing pastures, bird migration context, Ersta Battery and the northern cape loop. Current SAT facts use the shorter H25 route, while older PDF/Naturkartan/Explore sources still describe a longer 13.6-13.7 km variant.
utilities: Waste is not a supported normal preview facility in the current app model. SAT asks hikers to carry trash back and only use posted harbor waste stations if available and necessary.
Guest-harbor/hostel/lodging showers are guest/customer context only. OSM has a shower node near Norrhamn, but shower is not a supported normal preview facility.
Lodging/cottage sauna or hot-tub context is private/bookable metadata only, not a public trail facility.
